title: keranmob
body:
# KeranMob

**Advanced Vanilla Mob Editor for Paper & Folia (1.21+)**

KeranMob is a powerful plugin that allows server owners to **modify vanilla Minecraft mobs using a GUI**.

You can turn normal mobs into **bosses, mini-bosses, or RPG enemies** without writing scripts or complex configs.

KeranMob focuses on:

* performance
* vanilla compatibility
* simple GUI editing

---

# Features

## GUI Mob Editor

Open the mob editor with:

/keranmob
/km

A GUI will open showing **all vanilla mobs**.
Click any mob to edit it.

You can modify:

* health
* damage
* speed
* AI
* custom name
* equipment
* potion effects
* drops
* skills

---

# Custom Mob Name + Health Display

Mobs can display **name and health above their head**.

Example:

Boss Zombie ❤ 120 / 150

Health updates automatically when the mob takes damage or heals.

Excluded by default:

* Wither
* Ender Dragon

---

# Advanced Name Formatting

KeranMob supports multiple formatting styles.

### Standard colors

&cBoss Zombie

### Hex colors

&#FFAA00Boss Zombie

### MiniMessage

<red>Boss Zombie</red>

### Gradient text

[gradient:#ff0000:#00ffff](gradient:#ff0000:#00ffff)Boss Zombie</gradient>

---

# Custom Equipment System

Mobs can wear armor and hold weapons using **drag & drop GUI**.

Supported item data:

* enchantments
* lore
* custom model data
* NBT data

Example equipment:

Helmet: Netherite Helmet
Chestplate: Diamond Chestplate
Main Hand: Netherite Sword

Items are **cloned exactly** from the item you place.

---

# Loot Table Editor

KeranMob includes a **GUI loot table editor**.

Each drop entry supports:

* minimum amount
* maximum amount
* drop chance
* looting modifier

Example:

Diamond — 15%
Gold Ingot — 40%
Iron Sword — 5%

Each item rolls **independently** like chest loot tables.

---

# Vanilla Drop Compatibility

If a mob has **no custom drops configured**:

→ Vanilla drops remain unchanged.

If **Override Drops** is enabled:

→ Only custom drops will be used.

---

# Potion Effects

Mobs can have potion effects such as:

* Speed
* Strength
* Regeneration
* Fire Resistance

Random effects can also be enabled.

---

# Mob Skills

Multiple skills can be attached to a mob.

Examples:

* teleport when hurt
* fireball attack
* arrow volley
* regeneration aura

There is **no limit** to the number of skills.

---

# Language System

KeranMob supports multiple languages.

Folder:

plugins/KeranMob/lang/

Files:

en.yml
vi.yml

Select language in config:

language: vi

---

# Commands

/keranmob
/km
/km reload
/km help

---

# Permissions

keranmob.admin
keranmob.reload
keranmob.edit

---

# Compatibility

Supported servers:

Paper
Folia
Canvas

Minecraft version:

1.21+

---

# Use Cases

KeranMob is ideal for:

* survival servers
* RPG servers
* MMO servers
* dungeon servers

It allows creating **custom mobs without heavy scripting systems**.

---

# Roadmap

Planned future features:

* boss phases
* mob level scaling
* boss bars
* damage indicators
* MMOItems support
* ItemsAdder support

---

# Author
